rationale: The fix widens the pre-existing `except BadAPIRequestError` clause to also catch ValueError from empty API responses; the commit only added the unique_id removal block, which the fix does not touch.
The fix renames the commit's DESCRIPTION attribute to description and adds a new feature for installing missing ClientCommand requirements; the commit's lines are renamed, not repaired.

The fix (a PySwitchbot bump plus a new close_stale_connections call) addresses issue #77630, opened ten days before this commit, and leaves the commit's get_device fallback line unchanged; the dataset's link comes only from the version-pin lines in other files.

The async_update this commit added to the sampled file refreshes the shared data object but then updates only its own entity, without the update signal that the commit's own service handlers send; this is the failure the bugfix pull request names (the integration 'doesn't properly update all entities via the homeassistant.update_entity service'), and the fix deletes the method.

The real defect the fix repairs is the editable-install package name check ("lightning-app") from another commit; the commit's version log lines are only swapped from logger.info to print as a workaround, and that is not a functional defect in them.

The fix changes read_csv to stop filtering by file extension and wraps the commit's open_csv call in a try block to give a better error message; the commit's lines are only re-indented and nothing in them was wrong.

The fix adds an experimental all-silo model category and replaces filtered_names with an unfiltered to_name_pairs as part of that new feature, not to correct the commit's renamed silo_limit attribute check.

The fix quotes the GraphQL string arguments and reads blame.ranges, both in older code of client.py; this commit only added the committedDate field, which the fix keeps (the committedDate lookup bug was in integration.py).
The fix removes the obsolete --force flag from printed hint text; the flag was already in the old lines and the commit only inserted the 'setup' subcommand, which the fix keeps.

The fix adds a new policy of injecting the customer-domains feature flag whenever a customer domain is used, and swaps the commit's hasattr check for a shared is_using_customer_domain helper; neither is a demonstrated defect in the commit's lines.

The fix commit is described as 'Optimized handling None values': it extends the early return to None (str(None) did not crash), which is an optimisation and not a repair of the commit's empty-string guard.

The commit is a pure customer-to-region rename, and the fix adds a new all_silo_model category and replaces filtered_names with to_name_pairs, which is a feature extension, not a repair of the renamed lines.

The commit only refactored existing FK-index logic into _create_missing_fk_index; the fix repairs a pre-existing gap (remove_constraint/remove_index on FKs not handled) and generalises the helper for expressions, so the reformatted lines change for the new use, not because they were wrong.
The fix is step 4 of a planned field migration that renames app_id_str back to app_id; the commit's app_id_str line was correct for step 3 and is only renamed.

The commit runs the shell builtin `command -v` through subprocess without a shell and catches only FileNotFoundError, so on some non-SLURM platforms it raises a PermissionError; the fix replaces it with shutil.which.
The commit only renamed local variables, and the fix moves that logic into a new _LightningAppOpenAPIRetriever class with caching so CLI help works without a running app, which is a feature refactor.

The commit changed the editable-install check to look for a "lightning-app" egg-info that does not exist in the e2e install, so the function returned early and the PR's code was never packaged; the fix restores a package_name parameter that defaults to "lightning".

The commit's new get_blame_for_file builds a GraphQL query with unquoted string arguments (name, owner, ref, path), and it returns the blame object instead of its ranges list even though the query itself nests ranges under blame; the fix quotes the arguments and adds .get("ranges", []).

The commit builds category codes with np.arange(..., dtype=np.int8), which overflows when there are more than 127 categories and corrupts the category ordering; the fix drops the int8 dtype (the rest of its patch to this file is cleanup).
The commit passes mode=brotli.BrotliEncoderMode.TEXT, which does not exist in the brotli Python module; the fix uses the real constant brotli.MODE_TEXT.
The commit's movflags 'frag_keyframe' produced fragmented mp4s without an empty moov atom that some players fail to play back; the fix changes that same option to 'frag_keyframe+empty_moov'.
The fix only moves args = None from an else branch to before the if chain, which behaves the same; it is a refactor within the same PR, not a defect repair.
The fix adds a new 10Hz inactive send rate to reduce LKAS faults caused by lag; the commit's camera-counter initialisation condition is only moved into an init_lka_counter variable, not corrected.

The fix adds replay_id/project_id tags and switches capture_message to capture_exception in the duplicate-segment block to get more breadcrumbs, which improves diagnostics rather than fixing a functional defect; the broken configure_scope code it removes is older code.

The fix adds a `last_org is not None` guard before features.has as a side effect of stricter test-side parameter validation; the bundle does not show whether calling features.has with a None organisation actually misbehaves in production.
The fix is step 4 of a planned multi-step column migration that renames app_id_str to app_id; the commit's app_id_str line (step 1) was not wrong.

The fix repairs transaction filtering in other files and extends the allowlist this commit introduced to support it; before the commit such filters were dropped silently, so the commit's lines worked as intended and the missing support is older.
The fix replaces the commit's generic is_saas()/SENTRY_IS_SAAS flag with a dedicated SHOW_SESSION_REPLAY_BANNER setting, which is a configuration design change, not a functional defect.

The commit set bs = len(dataset) for every dataset, so for LoadImages the batch size became the number of files (breaking batch-dependent setup such as TensorRT warmup); the fix restores bs = 1 except for streams.
